quote: The driver of a vehicle shall not follow another vehicle more closely than is reasonable and prudent, having due regard for the speed of such vehicles and the traffic upon and the condition of the highway.

activation.condition: A vehicle driver follows another moving vehicle on a highway.

obligation.description: Do not follow more closely than reasonable and prudent, having due regard for both speeds, traffic and highway condition.

timing.description: Measure moving ego and leader in the same lane before the lane change, retaining the original steady interval and transition.

judgment_calls_needed.note: The statute supplies no numeric following-distance cutoff.
Both speeds, traffic and highway condition must inform the unresolved judgment.
